source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
historical_synonyms_documented: Rhus copallinum L. var. lanceolata A. Gray

morphology_documented.habit: Large shrub or small tree to 10 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Pinnately compound; leaf rachis winged, rachis plus wings usually <3.5 mm across; 13–19 linear-lanceolate leaflets, 4–9 times as long as wide, usually strongly falcate, usually glabrous

source_scope_note: Only traits documented in cited flora; null/omitted traits not inferred. Genus-key traits indicated where relevant.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Explicit historical rank conflict: Diggs 1999 recognizes R. lanceolata at species rank but lists R. copallinum var. lanceolata in synonymy; preserve current index concept pending authoritative modern taxonomic crosswalk
Not to be confused with flora's R. copallinum var. latifolia (rachis+wings on some leaves >4 mm; leaflets 7–17, 2–4× as long as wide)
preservation: Additive research record; original species.json, photos, credits, and galleries unchanged
